name: Sossou S. Adjisse, Ph.D.
expertise: Applied economics; causal inference; development and public policy
bio: Dr. Sossou S. Adjisse is an Assistant Professor of Economics at West Virginia State University. He serves as Lead Coordinator of ERS–WVSU and helps guide the seminar program, research-development activities, and interdisciplinary collaboration around economics, data analysis, and causal inference.
past_talk: Economics as a Meeting Place: Research, Collaboration, and Student Opportunity
past_talk_note: September 24, 2026 | 12:30–1:30 p.m. EDT. Inaugural ERS–WVSU seminar introducing the research exchange and interdisciplinary collaboration opportunities.
past_talk_summary: The inaugural seminar introduced ERS–WVSU as an economics-centered forum where faculty and students can turn disciplinary questions into more rigorous economic and empirical research. The presentation outlined opportunities for economic framing, data analysis, causal inference, student engagement, and collaborative research across the university.
